title_zh: 把烘焙店广告的地址留到结尾

scenario.goal_zh: 删减广告内容并确定结尾呈现的地址及停留时间。

context_zh: 烘焙店主与剪辑师讨论一则即将投放的短广告。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: The commercial looks lovely, but I missed the address at the end.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: As the editor, I can hold that final shot for longer. What should I cut?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: There is too much content for such a short commercial. We show all six cakes and then the whole menu.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: We could keep three cakes and remove the menu.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Yes. Could we conclude with the shop name and address instead of the slogan?

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: That gives viewers four seconds to read it. Shall I keep the opening music?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Please do. Make those changes and send me the shorter version.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: I will. The address will stay on screen until the music ends.

targets.sense_zh: 电视或网络等媒体中的商业广告
